findings.label: M1 P3 literal duplication
findings.detail: The M1 Part 3 Prompts tab hardcodes the Sales/Support prompt lists instead of sharing the inline `suggestions` variable. This is a documented exception because the Sales/Support selectbox renders after the diagram expander, so the variable is not yet in scope. The tab's four hardcoded strings are byte-for-byte identical to the two inline branches today, but future edits to one set will not propagate to the other.

findings.label: Unrelated demos/ changes in working tree
findings.detail: Roughly 40 files under demos/ are modified in the working tree (model-ID swaps, regenerated infra config.env, test tweaks). These are a separate pre-existing workstream and were not touched by this change, which lives entirely in app/pages/*.py per the task scope. They should be kept out of any commit scoped to the Prompts tab work.
